body:
Add Settings-page controls for assigning a default and backup model or agent to each defined role.

### Scope
- List the canonical roles from task:7e5105f14ac6e1ec in Settings.
- For each role, let the human choose a default and a backup from the configured models/agents.
- Persist assignments through the server-backed settings API and machine configuration, following the existing settings pattern.
- Keep missing or unknown assignments non-fatal: use the existing model fallback and show a clear empty state.
- Add focused tests for persistence, round-tripping and fallback behavior.

### Acceptance criteria
- Every defined role has independent default and backup selections in Settings.
- Assignments survive restart and are readable by the board.
- The page explains what default and backup mean in plain language.
- Invalid or missing configuration falls back without blocking the app.

### Out of scope
Defining role semantics, changing role names, defaulting model selectors elsewhere, Autorun, brief generation, and model-provider configuration.
title: Agent roles: assign models
